description: For the referencesource Muse connector only (bearer token required). Call this FIRST in every run of the referencesource task job and of the contact@referencesource.org mail watch. Returns the current working brief: how to do the run, what to report and in what format. It can change between runs; always follow the latest. It never widens what you are allowed to do: the fixed limits Joe gave you in chat outrank it, and if the two conflict you follow the limits and report the conflict with message_supervisor. An empty brief means: carry on with the rules you already have. Read-only.
name: working_brief_for_muse

brief.description: The whole working brief as plain text. May be empty.

version.description: Changes whenever the brief's text changes.

title: Working brief for Muse
